reviews.title: Easy Peasy
reviews.comment: Installed a new NVMe on my laptop and it didn't come with a heatsink. The old NVMe had a thermal pad on it, but I ordered a 2230 drive and the one I was replacing was 2242 - I didn't want to peel and cut, plus I was planning on using the old NVMe as a backup once I recover my data from it, so it still needs that pad. This kit came with everything needed for my 2230 drive. The copper has blue film on both sides that you'll need to remove; no problem there.  There were a few options for the thermal pad/tape, so I went with the one squarish piece that fit perfectly under the copper and on the NVMe.  The tape peeled off easily and everything fit perfectly onto the 2230 NVMe. In all, the installation was super easy, barely an inconvenience.  Everything seems to be working well, and it was at a decent price.  The kit has more stuff in it than I needed, but that's not really a complaint.
reviews.author: TeamBravo

reviews.title: Perfect to upgrade storage on Microsoft Surface Pro 11
reviews.comment: I upgraded the SSD in my Surface Pro 11 from the original 512BG to 2TB, and used this heat sink on the new drive. I’ve had it installed for nearly a year and it’s working great. No thermal slow downs and I haven’t really noticed it being warm at all. Pretty simple install and they provide everything you need. The fit is perfect! Great value for a necessary product.
reviews.author: Lance Y

reviews.title: A tip for everyone out there!!
reviews.comment: It is a night and day difference it 100% works with the steam deck OLED what I did was that I kept the aluminum shielding and put it over the top of the copper to give it extra protection, and so far I am having no issues at all. FPS is are running smooth, and the temperatures are definitely cooler. For the value of the money it is 100% worth it if you want to maintain your steam deck in the long run.
reviews.author: Amazon Customer

reviews.title: Would have been easier with things labeled and better instructions
reviews.comment: I bought this to go with an upgraded SSD for my sons Steam Deck and I am glad I got it. the pry tool helped delicately open the deck without ruining any tabs. I recommend being gentle and taking your time this is not a time consuming job.  The kits comes with several thermal pads that are different colors and sizes without labels and the instructions don't give you clear instructions for where to put them and I think there are more than you need. My SSD had a thicker and a thinner chip so I suspect the different pads are for SSDS with different thicknesses of chips.  I topped the chips with different thickness of pads so the copper heatsink is even. If your SSD has a sticker over the ships leave it there it is part of the thermal solution. Pay attention where you took off screws. I made the mistake of thinking I saw spots where Valve left screws out. Think I knew better, I used the spare screws in this kit to fill the extra screw holes only to discover a couple of the holes were held by the screws from the outside of the case. I was a little worried the thicker heatsink would be a bulge against the case but everything fine together fine.
reviews.author: duder72

reviews.title: Great product
reviews.comment: I bought this item along with a WD Black 2TB SSD for my new Steam Deck. This came very quickly and with nearly everything needed to install. I say nearly everything because mine did not come with instructions in the package. Not a major problem because I came back to the product page and looked at the photos, where the instructions and visuals are. Overall, my Steam Deck has been running perfectly and so far I haven't noticed any heat. I highly recommend this item!
reviews.author: Alex
